creator: buildwithneej
title: Creator switches Claude Code back from Opus 5 to Opus 4.6 for instruction-following and less over-engineering; the command is '/model claude-opus-4-6[1m]'

tools.name: Claude Opus 5
tools.detail: Described as highest benchmark scores but worse at staying on task

claims: Opus 5 benchmarks higher on 'literally everything' but over-engineers (three-line function into a design pattern), corrects you, is verbose
After a week side by side, Opus 4.6 'just does what you tell it to do'
One command switches back inside a Claude Code session
how_to_steps: In a Claude Code session type: /model claude-opus-4-6[1m]
on_screen_only: Title card 'The newest Claude model is worse'

relevance.why: Directly affects Haji's daily Claude Code use: if a newer Opus over-engineers, pinning an older model for routine execution tasks is a cheap lever. Anecdotal, one creator, one week.

implement_score.why: Zero cost to try: /model claude-opus-4-6[1m] for execution-heavy sessions, keep the newer model for planning. Pair with the liked 'Anthropic cut 80% of system prompt / replace NEVER rules' guidance and effort levels before downgrading.

verify: Is claude-opus-4-6[1m] still available on Haji's plan and is the 1M context a different price tier
Does over-engineering persist with lower effort level or a thin CLAUDE.md rather than a model change
Creator's 'prompts' are gated behind a comment; nothing shown beyond the /model line

gap.what: Adds a contrarian warning: newest Opus may over-engineer and ignore instructions; the exact /model fallback command. Liked set had model-release news but not a 'downgrade for obedience' take.
